info.name: Allomantic Abilities
info.description: Custom Allomantic abilities organized by metal category.
info.author: Devon

element.name: Allomancy
element.description: You can select one or more Allomantic metals. Each metal feature grants its associated Allomantic abilities.

description.p: You have learned to burn steel. Your steel Allomantic abilities use Dexterity for their save DC.
Allomantic save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier.

sheet.description: Steel Allomancy — Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier.

description.p: You have learned to burn iron. Your iron Allomantic abilities use Strength for their save DC.
Allomantic save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier.

sheet.description: Iron Allomancy — Save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier.

Allomantic save DC: 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier.

description.p: Requires level 1 Pewter Allomancy.
While burning, gain +2 STR (or +2 bonus to STR checks/attacks) and resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing.
Allomantic Upgrade. At level 5, the bonus grows to +3; melee attacks gain an extra 1d4 corresponding damage, and jumping and carrying capacity double
Requires level 7 Pewter Allomancy.
While burning, gain advantage on saves vs being knocked prone, stunned, or grappled; resist exhaustion.
Requires level 9 Pewter Allomancy.
For 3 turns, gain bonus +2 AC, extra attack once/turn, and immunity to frightened/poison/exhaustion. Recharge per long rest or per vial.
Requires level 9 Pewter Allomancy.
Auto-succeed 1 failed save per long rest while burning.
Requires level 1 Tin Allomancy.
Advantage on Perception checks; gain darkvision 60 ft (or extend existing).
Requires level 3 Tin Allomancy.
When you sense hidden enemies you may pinpoint their rough direction and get advantage on first hit.
Requires level 3 Tin Allomancy.
Detect poison, illusions, or unseen traps with a single Investigation check (no tool needed).
Requires level 5 Tin Allomancy.
Allies within 10 ft gain +2 to passive Perception and +1 Initiative.
Requires level 9 Tin Allomancy.
Sense through walls ≤30 ft (direction + silhouette); automatically succeed on one Perception/Investigation check per encounter.
Requires level 5 Gold Allomancy.
Once per long rest, you can ask the DM a single strong “what-if” or alternate history style clue that gives a concrete lead (investigative boon).
Requires level 9 Gold Allomancy.
Once per long rest you get a clear vision relevant to a major decision (campaign-level clue) or gain advantage to auto-succeed one critical skill check.
Prerequisite: Level 1 Steel Allomancy

Allomantic Upgrade. At level 3, Coin Push upgrades to 2 coins per Action, each dealing 1d6 + DEX piercing, and the range increases to 60 ft. You may target the same or different targets. At level 5, you can push or manipulate up to 3 metal anchors in the same turn, spread across your Action and Allomantic Reactions, and the vault distance increases to 40 ft. At level 7, you can fire 3 coins, each dealing 1d8 + DEX piercing, choosing a large spread or precision. At level 9, the attack becomes Steelstorm and you gain Steel Flight: sustained pushes let you ride pushes between anchors, effectively controlled hovering/glide up to 60 ft per round while anchor contact exists.
Fire 1 metal piece as a ranged attack (30ft) Hit: 1d4 + DEX piercing.
Prerequisite: Level 1 Steel Allomancy

Allomantic Upgrade. At level 5, the vault distance increases to 40 ft. At level 9, you can push or manipulate up to 3 metal anchors in the same turn, spread across your Action and Allomantic Reactions.
If there is a nearby metal anchor vault up to 20 feet away from it.

setters.set: dexterity, bonus action, movement, allomancy, steel

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Steel Allomancy
Impose disadvantage on one incoming metallic ranged attack that targets you or an ally.

setters.set: dexterity, reaction, disadvantage, deflect, allomancy, steel

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Steel Allomancy
Allomantic Upgrade. At level 7, if you successfully push a metal-clad target, they suffer +1d6 bludgeoning as your push slams metal into armor or limbs and stuns them if hitting an obstacle.
When you push against a metal-worn target, they must make a STR save vs your Allomancy DC or be pushed 10 ft and knocked prone if they hit an obstacle.

setters.set: strength, action, bonus action, shove, prone, allomancy, steel

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 9 Steel Allomancy
Spray of metal pieces; targets make a DEX save, or take 3d6 piercing (halved on save).
Prerequisite: Level 1 Iron Allomancy

Allomantic Upgrade. At level 3, Pull Metal upgrades to 2 metal objects per Action, each targetable independently, and the range increases to 60 ft. At level 5, you can manipulate up to 3 metal sources in a single turn. At level 7, the attack can pull 3 metal objects and you can disarm 2 targets; Iron Net becomes available to coordinate up to 3 small metal items in a 30-ft spread, forcing STR saves or restraining the target for 1 round or dealing 2d8 + STR bludgeoning. At level 9, Ironstorm pulls and flings all unsecured metal objects within 30 ft towards yourself.
Pull 1 metal piece as a ranged attack (30ft) Hit: 1d4 + STR piercing. If the metal object is held, target makes a contested STR save, on fail you rip it free if held or yanks them 10 ft if worn.
Prerequisite: Level 1 Iron Allomancy

Allomantic Upgrade. At level 5, the sprint distance increases to 40 ft. At level 7, you can swing between anchors with complete control (treat as expert Acrobatics; no falling on a failed check). At level 9, this increases to 60 ft.
If there is a nearby metal anchor vault up to 20 feet towards it.

setters.set: strength, bonus action, movement, allomancy, iron

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Iron Allomancy
Impose disadvantage on one incoming metallic ranged attack that targets you or an ally. You may redirect it slightly.

setters.set: strength, reaction, disadvantage, deflect, allomancy, iron

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Iron Allomancy
Pull an anchor so forcefully it yanks a creature into prone or a hazard (10 ft), targetted creature makes a STR save to resist.
Allomantic Upgrade. At level 7, if you successfully pull a metal-clad target, they suffer +1d6 bludgeoning as the back of their armor caves in.

setters.set: strength, action, bonus action, yank, prone, allomancy, iron

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 9 Iron Allomancy
Pull all unsecured metal objects within 30 feet towards yourself; targets make a DEX save, or take 1d6 piercing (halved on save) per object in path.
Prerequisite: Level 9 Iron Allomancy
You may pull all metal aimed at you to a piece of armor on yourself. STR save (DC 10). Warning: the metal can still bounce and hit you.
Prerequisite: Level 1 Pewter Allomancy
On hit, add +1d8 damage.
Prerequisite: Level 1 Pewter Allomancy
When reduced to 0 HP, make a CON save (DC 10) to stay at 1 HP instead of falling unconscious. Uses 1 Allomantic Reaction.
Prerequisite: Level 3 Pewter Allomancy
Spend an Action or Bonus Action to gain temporary HP equal to 1d6 + CON, to a maximum of 25.

setters.set: constitution, action, bonus action, temporary hp, pewter, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Pewter Allomancy
Make a ground slam, affected targets make a STR save or are knocked prone and take 1d6 bludgeoning.

setters.set: strength, action, prone, damage, pewter, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 7 Pewter Allomancy
Move 20+ ft before an attack using current speed, if you do, add an extra 2d6 damage on one hit.

setters.set: strength, action, movement, damage, pewter, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 9 Pewter Allomancy
For 3 turns, gain bonus AC (+ 2 AC), extra attack once/turn, and immunity to frightened/poison/exhaustion. Recharge per long rest or per vial.
Prerequisite: Level 1 Tin Allomancy
For 1 round, gain advantage on attack rolls against invisible or hidden targets and on Insight checks.

setters.set: wisdom, action, perception, invisible, hidden, tin, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Tin Allomancy
Grant one ally within 30 ft advantage on a DEX save. Uses 1 Allomantic Reaction.
Prerequisite: Level 7 Tin Allomancy
For 1 minute, gain truesight, perceive through invisibility, illusions, and darkness; see true forms within 30 ft.
Prerequisite: Level 7 Tin Allomancy
Grant allies within 10 ft advantage on Initiative or add +5 to Initiatives one time per vial.

setters.set: wisdom, bonus action, initiative, tin, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Zinc Allomancy
Target makes a WIS save. On a failure, apply a mild emotional state for 1 turn, such as distracted or slightly enraged; the DM defines a small mechanical +1 or -1.

setters.set: charisma, action, mental, emotion, zinc, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Zinc Allomancy
Impose disadvantage on an enemy’s WIS or CHA save against other Allomancy. Uses 1 Allomantic Reaction.

setters.set: charisma, reaction, disadvantage, mental, zinc, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Zinc Allomancy
Choose up to 3 creatures within 30 ft; they make WIS saves. On a failure, they are compelled to attack the nearest target for 1 turn, or become Frightened if you choose.

setters.set: charisma, action, mental, frenzy, frightened, zinc, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Zinc Allomancy
Instill courage: targeted ally or allies gain +1d4 to attacks and saves for 1 minute.

setters.set: charisma, action, bonus action, support, zinc, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 5 Zinc Allomancy
Create a 15 ft aura centered on you. Enemies in the aura have -1 to WIS saves against emotional influence; allies gain +1 to attack rolls.
Allomantic Upgrade. At level 9, Riot Mastery extends the aura to 30 ft and your emotional effects can impose Frightened, Charmed, or Confused on failed saves for 1 turn.

setters.set: charisma, action, aura, emotion, zinc, allomancy, upgrade

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 7 Zinc Allomancy
Choose to push enemies into Frenzy (must attack) or heavy Panic (Frightened) in a 20 ft cone. WIS save negates. Effects last 5 turns.

setters.set: charisma, action, cone, frenzy, frightened, mental, zinc, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 7 Zinc Allomancy
Target makes a WIS save, on failure targed is confused for 1 turn (DM fiat).

setters.set: charisma, bonus action, confusion, mental, zinc, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Brass Allomancy
Target makes a WIS save or has strong emotion dampened, such as stopping a rage or ending Frightened for 1 round.

setters.set: charisma, action, mental, emotion, brass, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Brass Allomancy
Allow an ally to reroll a failed WIS save against charm or fear. Uses 1 Allomantic Reaction.

setters.set: charisma, reaction, reroll, charm, fear, brass, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Brass Allomancy
Choose up to 3 creatures within 30 ft; WIS saves or have emotions dampened, ending rage, calming frenzy, or removing Frightened.

setters.set: charisma, action, mental, emotion, brass, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Brass Allomancy
Target makes a WIS save or is Charmed for 1 turn; you choose the mood to manipulate.

setters.set: charisma, action, bonus action, charm, mental, brass, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 5 Brass Allomancy
Create a 15 ft aura. Enemies within have -1 to attack rolls and saves against charm/fear; allies in the aura have advantage against being Frightened.
Allomantic Upgrade. At level 9, Soothing Mastery extends the aura to 30 ft, grants allies advantage against charm/fear, and lets you end one ongoing magical emotional effect per minute while burning.

setters.set: charisma, action, aura, charm, fear, brass, allomancy, upgrade

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 7 Brass Allomancy
A 20 ft radius calming wave removes one condition (Frightened or enraged) from allies and may calm enemies; WIS save or take -2 to attacks for 3 turns.

setters.set: charisma, action, aura, condition, mental, brass, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 7 Brass Allomancy
A target WIS save or be Charmed for 5 turns on failure; target repeats the save at the end of their turn on fail to break the Charmed state early.

setters.set: charisma, action, charm, mental, brass, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Copper Allomancy
Create a 15 ft radius cloud centered on you. Within the cloud, Allomantic detection (Bronze) fails and mental metals have reduced range/effect. Lasts while you burn or until dismissed.

Allomantic Upgrade. At level 3, Expanded Cloud increases the radius to 30 ft. At level 5, enemies in cloud suffer disadvantage on being detected by Bronze and allies have +1 to saves vs mental Allomancy. At level 7, Hardened Cloud resists magical detection and enemies inside suffer -1 to attack and damage. At level 9, Impenetrable Smother makes the cloud effectively a sanctuary against Allomantic and divination detection.

setters.set: charisma, action, concealment, detection, copper, allomancy, upgrade

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Copper Allomancy
As a reaction, suppress one Allomantic effect targeting an ally within the cloud; it is negated for 1 turn.

Allomantic Upgrade. At level 3, Smother Advanced lets you redirect a single Allomantic effect to a non-critical metal object rather than the ally. At level 9, Impenetrable Smother allows Copper to cancel up to 2 separate Allomantic effects per turn within the cloud.

setters.set: charisma, reaction, suppression, defense, copper, allomancy, upgrade

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 7 Copper Allomancy
Create a denser band in the cloud that blocks projectiles made of metal for 1 turn; objects bounce off.

setters.set: charisma, bonus action, defense, projectile, copper, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Bronze Allomancy
Sense which metal is burning within 30 ft; the type is known and you learn its rough direction.

Allomantic Upgrade. At level 3, Extended Sense increases the range to 60 ft and lets you distinguish the number of burners and whether they are moving. At level 5, Pulse Read lets you gauge burn intensity (strong or weak) and track stronger burns through thin walls. At level 7, you pick up residual burns in an area (last 10 minutes) and can trace where burners were recently active.

setters.set: wisdom, action, detection, bronze, allomancy, upgrade

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Bronze Allomancy
When a new metal is burned within range, you immediately know. Uses 1 Allomantic Reaction.
Prerequisite: Level 3 Bronze Allomancy
Within 30 ft, reveal the exact location of a burner, subject to cover. Uses 1 Allomantic Reaction.
Prerequisite: Level 7 Bronze Allomancy
Force a CON save against your Allomancy DC from a nearby burner; on a failure, their burning is suppressed for 2 turns.
Prerequisite: Level 9 Bronze Allomancy
Detect burns through walls or ground up to 90 ft and disrupt up to 2 burners with a large CON-based suppression once per long rest.

setters.set: wisdom, action, detection, suppression, bronze, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Gold Allomancy
You glimpse an alternate version of yourself; gain advantage on one saving throw you can use this round.

setters.set: wisdom, action, vision, save, gold, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 1 Gold Allomancy
Force attackers to reroll one attack and take the second roll. Uses 1 Allomantic Reaction.
Allomantic Upgrade. At level 7, you can also target an enemy's saving throw.

setters.set: wisdom, reaction, reroll, fate, gold, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Gold Allomancy
Give an ally advantage on Initiative or their next attack, one time.

setters.set: wisdom, bonus action, vision, initiative, gold, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 3 Gold Allomancy
Ask a single yes/no question about immediate events; the DM may answer cryptically.

setters.set: wisdom, action, prophecy, vision, gold, allomancy

description.p: Prerequisite: Level 7 Gold Allomancy
For 5 turns, emulate an alternate-self template: gain +1 to saves and reroll one failed save per turn.

setters.set: wisdom, action, reroll, saves, gold, allomancy
